def valid_id(value: i64) -> bool:
    return value > 0

# A small explicit HTTP app with JSON responses and no database writes.
# The root route uses plain UTF-8 text; typed HTML is available via http.html_response.
import std.http.server as http

class State:
    greeting: str

class Greeting:
    id: i64
    name: str

async def home(request: http.Request, state: shared[State], authority: unit) -> Result[http.Response, Error]:
    return http.text(http.response_context(view(request)), http.Status.OK, view(state.greeting))

async def greet(request: http.Request, state: shared[State], authority: unit) -> Result[http.Response, Error]:
    id_text = try slice(request.path, 7, len(request.path))
    id = try parse_i64(id_text)
    if not valid_id(id):
        return error("id must be positive")
    value = Greeting(id=id, name="Nagi")
    return http.json[Greeting](http.response_context(view(request)), http.Status.OK, value)

async def echo(request: http.Request, state: shared[State], authority: unit) -> Result[http.Response, Error]:
    value = try json_decode[Greeting](request.body)
    return http.json[Greeting](http.response_context(view(request)), http.Status.OK, value)

async def main() -> Result[unit, Error]:
    app = http.app_default[State](State(greeting="Hello, Nagi!"))
    app = try http.route(app, http.Method.GET, "/", http.public_policy[State](), home)
    route_policy_1 = try http.rate_policy(1000, 1000)
    app = try http.rate_route(app, http.Method.GET, "/", route_policy_1)
    app = try http.route(app, http.Method.GET, "/greet/{id}", http.public_policy[State](), greet)
    route_policy_2 = try http.rate_policy(1000, 1000)
    app = try http.rate_route(app, http.Method.GET, "/greet/{id}", route_policy_2)
    app = try http.route(app, http.Method.POST, "/echo", http.public_policy[State](), echo)
    route_policy_3 = try http.rate_policy(1000, 1000)
    app = try http.rate_route(app, http.Method.POST, "/echo", route_policy_3)
    limits = http.default_options()
    limits = try http.authority(limits, "https://localhost", ["localhost:54785", "127.0.0.1:54785"], 2, 256)
    # Explicit illustrative profile only; not a production sizing or SLA recommendation.
    response_budget = try http.response_limits(
        1048576, 8192, 32, 8192, 32, 65536, 64, 83886080, 1024, 285212672, 8192, 32
    )
    limits = try http.with_response_limits(limits, response_budget)
    rate_budget = try http.rate_limits(64, 64, 4096, 4194304, 65536)
    limits = try http.with_rate_limits(limits, rate_budget)
    return await http.serve(app, 54785, limits)
